phase.description: Represents the reconciliation phase of a resource as seen by the main resource controller.

observedGeneration.description: Resource generation that was last seen by the main resource controller.

observedAt.description: Time when the controller seen the resource state as defined in `observedGeneration`.

reconciledGeneration.description: Resource generation that was last successfully reconciled by the main resource controller.

reconciledAt.description: Time when the controller last reconciled the desired resource state as defined in `reconciledGeneration`.

conditions.description: Detailed conditions describing the state of the resource that are added by controllers.
